1.4.2-beta.title: Ops Copilot Preview
1.4.2-beta.body: Server → Ops Copilot lets admins ask plain questions like “why is Dune buffering for Mum?”, “free 500 GB without touching favourites” or “anything stuck in downloads?”. It explains transcodes, library space and download health from your own data, and anything that would change something is shown as a dry-run plan you approve or cancel. Pausing a stalled download and messaging a session can run after approval (pauses can be undone); deletions stay as proposals for now. Every question and decision is kept in an audit log.

1.4.2-beta.title: Wrapped Recaps By Email Or Webhook
1.4.2-beta.body: Statistics → Recap now lets you schedule a weekly or monthly Wrapped for any user, with top shows, hours watched and the busiest day. Recaps arrive by email or on one of your webhooks as soon as each week or month finishes, with the recap card attached. Users can set up email delivery of their own recap, and Send now resends the last finished period whenever you like.

1.4.2-beta.title: Meet Blobbo
1.4.2-beta.body: Blobbo, a friendly little jellyfish, now floats in the corner of your dashboard. Tap it, or press Shift+A anywhere to say hello, for tips, quick links and answers about your server. Its chat now matches your chosen theme colours, it stays still if you prefer reduced motion, and you can show or hide it under Settings → General. Blobbo's idle animation now has a properly transparent background, so the dark square behind it is gone.

1.4.2-beta.title: Ask Blobbo About Your Server
1.4.2-beta.body: Ask who is watching, how busy today was, how much space your libraries take up, what is new, who watches most, whether everything is healthy, if downloads are stuck, or if you are up to date. Blobbo now understands far more ways of asking, gives clearer answers straight from your server data, and always links to the full page. Tap a topic chip or type your own question.

1.4.2-beta.title: Find A Title With Blobbo
1.4.2-beta.body: Ask Blobbo to find a film or show, for example “find Dune” or “do I have The Expanse?”, and it lists the matches from your libraries. Each result, and titles in answers about what is playing, what is new and what is most watched, comes with Open in… buttons that take you straight to the title in JellyGlance or Jellyfin.

1.4.2-beta.title: Blobbo Remembers And Suggests
1.4.2-beta.body: After each answer Blobbo offers a few follow-up questions to tap. Your last five questions stay in this browser so you can ask them again in one tap, and More topics shows everything Blobbo knows. Ask Blobbo to explain the page you are on, and look for the Ask Blobbo button beside it on every page.

1.4.2-beta.title: Digests And Picks
1.4.2-beta.body: Ask what changed since yesterday, for a weekend digest, who has been offline, what is trending, for something to watch from your newest arrivals, for titles similar to your taste, or about your achievement badges.

1.4.2-beta.title: Troubleshooting With Blobbo
1.4.2-beta.body: Blobbo can explain why something is buffering, why a download failed, how scheduled tasks are doing, whether new devices have joined and whether remote access looks right. It can also hunt for duplicate films and empty series, draw a storage per library pie and a transcode heat map. Its mood now follows server health, so a worried Blobbo means a check needs a look.

1.4.2-beta.title: Getting To Know Blobbo
1.4.2-beta.body: New installs get a short guided tour and an optional setup quiz, there is a tip of the day when you sign in, and Blobbo says welcome back after an upgrade. Under Options you can turn on kids-safe answers, have answers read aloud and let Blobbo wear seasonal outfits. Tips can now be translated.

1.4.2-beta.title: Cleanuparr Integration
1.4.2-beta.body: Connect Cleanuparr under Integrations → 3rd party apps to see its strikes, removals, cleaned downloads and client and arr health on the Downloads page. Point Cleanuparr's Gotify notifications at JellyGlance and downloads it is already handling are tagged instead of raising stuck download alerts, while failed imports, errored downloads and repeated stalls alert you because they need a look.

1.4.0.title: Made For Phones And Tablets
1.4.0.body: Phones and smaller tablets get a bottom tab bar, with More for the rest of your pages, your account and Install app. The main pages have proper phone and tablet layouts, detail pages get a back button, and installing as an app is cleaner. Desktop is unchanged.

1.4.0.title: Safer Single Sign-On
1.4.0.body: OIDC sign-in now properly checks every login with your provider's signing keys, so a forged or replayed login can't get in. Accounts are linked more carefully, so a matching username at the provider can't take over an existing account, and you can map provider groups to JellyGlance roles.

1.4.0.title: Viewers See Only Their Own Activity
1.4.0.body: Viewers now only see their own history, stats, wrap-up and profile, across the Activity page, the most active lists and the Timeline. Opening someone else's profile shows Profile not available. Owners, admins and managers still see everyone, as before.

1.4.0.title: Locked-Down Media Server Checks
1.4.0.body: Only admins can change or test the media server address, and those checks refuse loopback, link-local and cloud metadata addresses. Running Jellyfin or Emby on the same host? Set JS_ALLOW_LOOPBACK_MEDIA_SERVER=true. LAN servers work as before.

1.4.0.title: Every Stream Counted
1.4.0.body: When one person or device plays more than one thing at once, each stream now gets its own history entry, watch time and start and stop notifications. Stopping one stream no longer ends or silences the other.

1.4.0.title: Faster Stats And Optional History Clean-Up
1.4.0.body: Views over time and Popular days now load several times faster on big libraries, with the same numbers. You can also trim old per-play history under Settings → Health → Playback History Retention. It's off by default and permanent, so back up first.

1.4.0.title: Smarter Alert Rules
1.4.0.body: Alerts can now fire on events too: a new user, the media server going down or coming back, new library items or a new device. Each rule can post to Discord, Gotify or a webhook, with its own cooldown and a Send test button. Existing rules keep working as before.

1.4.0.title: Books, Photos, Trailers And Home Videos
1.4.0.body: Music video, home video, book, audiobook, photo and trailer libraries now sync properly instead of showing as empty, and they get their own icons, labels and counts across the library pages and stats.

1.4.0.title: Redesigned Plugins Page
1.4.0.body: The Jellyfin plugins page shows a clear status for every plugin, groups duplicate copies left behind by updates, counts only plugins that are really running, and adds search and filters.

1.4.0.title: Home Keeps Your Layout
1.4.0.body: Your saved Home layout, pins and sizes now survive updates and expired sign-ins. Active sessions stays at the top of the built-in layouts even when requests need attention, and the layout editor shows the full width labels again.

1.4.0.title: Tidier Media Server Settings
1.4.0.body: The Jellyfin Connection card has the form and the connection status side by side, a hidden saved API key, Test connection and Update in one row, and a clearer pass, warning or fail result for each check.

1.4.0.title: 45 More Languages
1.4.0.body: JellyGlance now speaks 55 languages, with 45 new ones including Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Dutch, Swedish, Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese. Pick yours from the language picker, where each one is listed under its own name. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu switch the whole layout to right-to-left.

1.4.0.title: More Of JellyGlance In Your Language
1.4.0.body: Dates and numbers now follow the language you pick. The user wrap-up, profile rails and Wizarr invites are translated, the wrap-up is in German, the connection test is in Czech, and Wizarr's invite buttons have clear screen reader labels.

1.4.0.title: Smaller Fixes
1.4.0.body: crypto-js is gone, and older newsletter SMTP passwords are upgraded next time you save. The About page lists every contributor, and Documentation opens docs.jellyglance.com. Nothing to change on your side, just update and restart.

1.3.4.title: Test Your Media Server Connection
1.3.4.body: Settings → Media server now has a Test connection panel for admins. It checks the saved Jellyfin or Emby address and API key live and tells you in plain language what is wrong, instead of leaving you with empty lists and a 404 in the logs.

1.3.4.title: Deluge 2 Connection Test Fixed
1.3.4.body: Testing a Deluge 2.x download client no longer fails with "Unknown method". Older Deluge 1.3 setups keep working too.

1.3.4.title: Safer Media Server Checks
1.3.4.body: Only admins can change or check the media server address now, and JellyGlance refuses to send those checks to loopback, link-local or cloud metadata addresses or follow redirects. Media servers on your LAN work exactly as before.

1.3.4.title: Cleaner Restarts
1.3.4.body: When the container stops or restarts, JellyGlance now stops its background tasks and closes the database connection cleanly, so restarts are quicker and tidier.

1.3.4.title: Dependency Updates
1.3.4.body: React 19.3.1, js-yaml 5.5.0, qs 6.16.1 and a refreshed Node base image. Nothing to change on your side, just update and restart.

1.3.3.title: Now On The New Image Only
1.3.3.body: From v1.3.3, updates are only published to ghcr.io/jellyglance/server:latest. If you are still on the old image, change the image: line in your docker-compose file (or your docker run command) to it, then pull and restart. Your settings and history stay as they are.

1.3.3.title: Server Addresses With A Trailing Slash
1.3.3.body: A Jellyfin or Emby address ending in / (for example http://192.168.1.10:8096/) no longer breaks user lists and other requests with 404 errors. Saved addresses and the JF_HOST setting are cleaned up automatically, and addresses with a subpath like /jellyfin keep working.

1.3.3.title: New Project Home
1.3.3.body: JellyGlance now lives at github.com/JellyGlance/Server, with the guides at JellyGlance/Documentation. Links in the app, README and issue forms point to the new locations, and old links redirect.

1.3.3.title: Dependency Update
1.3.3.body: fast-uri is updated to 4.2.2. Nothing to change on your side, just update and restart.

1.3.2.title: New Docker Image: Please Switch
1.3.2.body: After v1.3.2, JellyGlance updates will only be published to the JellyGlance/Server image, ghcr.io/jellyglance/server:latest. Change the image: line in your docker-compose file (or your docker run command) to it as soon as possible, then pull and restart. Settings shows a reminder until you have switched.

1.3.2.title: Čeština
1.3.2.body: JellyGlance now speaks Czech. Pick Čeština from the language menu to switch, with proper Czech plural forms throughout.

1.3.2.title: Easier To Report And Contribute
1.3.2.body: The bug report, feature, docs and integration request forms are back on GitHub, and labels, assignments and bot comments now work on pull requests from forks.

1.3.2.title: A Leaner Repository
1.3.2.body: The jellyglance.com website now lives in its own JellyGlance/Website repository, keeping this one focused on the app. Nothing to change on your side, just update and restart.

1.3.1.title: Security Patches
1.3.1.body: proxy-addr is updated to 2.0.8 and sharp to 0.35.5 to fix a reported vulnerability, with source-map-js and shell-quote also moved to patched versions.

1.3.1.title: Fresher Foundations
1.3.1.body: An updated Node base image, a cleaner lockfile and the latest MUI icons, ESLint and build tooling. Nothing to change on your side, just update and restart.

1.3.0.title: Emby Support
1.3.0.body: Pick Jellyfin or Emby during setup, or let JellyGlance detect it for you. Emby installs sign in with their Emby username and password, can import history from the Emby Playback Reporting plugin, and see Emby wording throughout.

1.3.0.title: Audiobookshelf
1.3.0.body: Connect Audiobookshelf under Settings > Integrations > 3rd party apps to see who is listening, recent sessions, library totals and newly added books under Server > Audiobooks.

1.3.0.title: Weekly And Monthly Recaps
1.3.0.body: The Recap tab now covers a week, a month or a year. Step back through past periods and tap Share card to save a ready-to-post image of any recap.

1.3.0.title: Custom Alert Rules
1.3.0.body: Build your own alerts for active streams, transcodes, one user running several streams, bandwidth, disk space or the download queue, with optional active hours. Presets cover late-night streaming and account sharing.

1.3.0.title: Faster, Steadier Under The Hood
1.3.0.body: Fixes for integrations on custom ports, tighter protection of saved API keys and secrets, no more blank pages after quick reloads, a setup wizard that works on smaller screens, a single MUI version and new automated tests.

1.2.11.title: Statistics, Users And Server Hubs
1.2.11.body: The side menu is tidier. Related pages now sit as tabs under Statistics, Users and Server, and old links still take you to the right place.

1.2.11.title: Year In Review And Insights
1.2.11.body: See your year in review, a library health report, stream and transcode insights, and shows you have started but not finished.

1.2.11.title: Achievements And Watch Goals
1.2.11.body: My Glance now has 13 badges with Bronze to Platinum tiers, a yearly watch goal, and “Because you watched” suggestions.

1.2.11.title: Public Status Page
1.2.11.body: Build a public status page from blocks in Settings, with a live preview and regular Jellyfin uptime checks. Threshold alerts warn you when things go wrong.

1.2.11.title: Request Rules And Quotas
1.2.11.body: Set per-user request quotas and auto-approve rules. The Requests page adds summary tiles, Approve all pending, and a Movies/TV filter.

1.2.11.title: Jellyfin And Trakt Imports
1.2.11.body: Pull watch history in from Jellyfin or Trakt. All imports now run in the background with a progress bar.

1.2.11.title: Notifications, Webhooks And Newsletters
1.2.11.body: Notifications arrive in-app, on desktop or on mobile with per-type toggles. Webhooks get richer Discord and Gotify cards, and newsletters have a block-based builder.

1.2.11.title: Install JellyGlance As An App
1.2.11.body: Add JellyGlance to your phone or desktop as an app (needs HTTPS). Settings also has a search box to find any option fast.

1.2.11.title: Fixes And Privacy
1.2.11.body: NZBGet now signs in with a username and password. Year in review and Up next only show people their own data unless they are an admin.

1.2.11.title: Hardened API
1.2.11.body: Every medium, high, and critical CodeQL finding is closed. Outbound requests go through one sanitised helper, and static routes are rate limited.

1.2.11.title: Stronger Sign-In
1.2.11.body: Passwords use scrypt only and sessions expire after 12 hours. Accounts still on the old SHA3 hash need a password reset.

1.2.11.title: Unraid And Proxmox
1.2.11.body: Install from Unraid Community Apps templates or spin up a Proxmox LXC with the new packaging scripts.

1.2.11.title: Nightly Builds
1.2.11.body: A nightly GHCR image tracks main. Images run Node 25 on amd64 and arm64, and Node 22 on arm/v7.

1.2.11.title: Docs Have A New Home
1.2.11.body: Documentation now lives in its own repository and is published at jellyglance.com.

1.2.11.title: Fresher Foundations
1.2.11.body: MUI 9, Vite 8, and ESLint 10, with Renovate keeping dependencies current from here on.

1.2.10.title: Token Widget API
1.2.10.body: Homarr and Homepage poll compact JSON for sessions, queues, catalog, requests, and ops — real Glance data, not a health ping.

1.2.10.title: Widgets-Only API Keys
1.2.10.body: New keys default to GET widget routes only. Full keys keep the previous /api behaviour. Existing keys stay full until you change them.

1.2.10.title: Homarr And Homepage Kit
1.2.10.body: Copy or download 36 Homarr widgets and a Homepage YAML pack from Settings → API Key. Homarr never stores the key in the file — paste x-api-token after import.

1.2.10.title: Now Playing, Repair, Issues
1.2.10.body: New tiles for live sessions, repair counts, weekly stats, Seerr issues, newsletter, and Jellyfin jobs. Item glance stays Homarr-only.

1.2.10.title: API Key Page
1.2.10.body: Keys show last used and scope. Widget files sit in grouped rows with a filter. Swagger opens in its own tab instead of an iframe.

1.2.10.title: Try Routes In Swagger
1.2.10.body: Authorize with x-api-token and use the Widgets tag, or try a route from Settings. Standalone UI is at /swagger-ui.

1.2.9.title: Full Download Client Queues
1.2.9.body: Transmission, Deluge, NZBGet, and rTorrent now poll, add, pause, and remove like qBittorrent and SABnzbd.

1.2.9.title: Session Command
1.2.9.body: Owners and admins can stop a live stream or send an on-screen Jellyfin message. Cards explain why a session is transcoding.

1.2.9.title: Stream Capacity on Home
1.2.9.body: Watch concurrent streams versus a configured cap, split transcode vs direct play, and alert when you go over.

1.2.9.title: Honest Navigation
1.2.9.body: Timeline sits in the main menu. Calendar stays hidden until Sonarr, Radarr, or Lidarr is connected. SickChill is health-only.

1.2.9.title: ntfy and Telegram Alerts
1.2.9.body: Webhooks can deliver the same events to ntfy topics and Telegram bots alongside Discord and Gotify.

1.2.9.title: Installable Dashboard
1.2.9.body: JellyGlance can be installed as a standalone PWA for phone or kiosk home screens.

1.2.9.title: Item Glance And My Glance
1.2.9.body: Item pages stitch Jellyfin, Seerr, Arr, downloads, Tdarr, and Maintainerr. Viewers get a My Glance page for continue watching, watchlist, and their requests.

1.2.9.title: Ops Digest And Storage
1.2.9.body: Home surfaces stuck downloads, webhook failures, live Jellyfin jobs, and on-disk library size with an Arr upcoming-size estimate.

1.2.9.title: Pushover, Readarr, And Widgets
1.2.9.body: Webhooks can target Pushover. Readarr joins the Arr calendar. Homepage can poll /api/widgets/homepage with an API key. Unpackerr and Kometa connect as health pings.

1.2.9.title: Playback Quality Repair
1.2.9.body: Repair Hub lists clients that keep transcoding and titles that fail to start, with jumps into Activity.

1.2.9.title: Retry Grab And S3 Backups
1.2.9.body: Retry a failed Arr/Seerr grab from item glance or Downloads. Backups can copy to S3-compatible storage. autobrr, Notifiarr, and Recyclarr connect as status integrations.

1.2.9.title: Quiet Hours And Ops Shortcuts
1.2.9.body: Mute overnight playback webhooks, send a morning digest of what you missed, retry a failed delivery from Health, refresh or scan in Jellyfin, and see who is watching now. Downloads show why a torrent stalled. Nav and Home warn when Jellyfin is down.

1.2.9.title: Themes That Follow You
1.2.9.body: Search and preview palettes in Settings or the account menu. Apply when you are ready. The chosen theme is stored on your account so it comes back on another device.

1.2.9.title: Jellyfin Job Schedules
1.2.9.body: Set daily, weekly, interval, or startup times for Jellyfin library scans, metadata, and other scheduled jobs from Settings. The Jellyfin Jobs page shows those times and still lets you run a job now.

1.2.9.title: Jellyfin Admins On Users
1.2.9.body: Server administrators show up on Users again, with a Jellyfin admin badge when their Glance role is not Admin.

1.2.9.title: Tighter Discord Cards
1.2.9.body: Playback and status webhook images wrap long titles instead of clipping, on a smaller card that fits Discord better.

1.2.9.title: Cleaner Tdarr Labels
1.2.9.body: Active Transcodes no longer prints [object Object] for format, status, or reason — those fields resolve to readable text.

1.2.9.title: Desktop Layout Without Zoom
1.2.9.body: Desktop pages no longer look zoomed or soft. Type, spacing, and the sidebar stay sharp and a bit denser.

1.2.9.title: Quick Connect Starts Itself
1.2.9.body: Login with Jellyfin Quick Connect now begins the approval flow as soon as the page is ready.

1.2.8.title: More Stable Under Playback Load
1.2.8.body: Webhook bursts and overlapping playback activity no longer crash-loop JellyGlance. Materialized view refreshes are debounced and run in a safer order.

1.2.8.title: Richer Discord and Gotify Alerts
1.2.8.body: Playback and download webhooks can send poster cards (with the viewer avatar on Discord). Session flicker spam is filtered, episode starts notify cleanly, and Gotify gets image-friendly extras when your server supports them.

1.2.8.title: Skip the First-Run Wizard
1.2.8.body: Docker and Compose installs can seed Jellyfin plus a local admin from environment variables and optionally skip first-run extras, restore a backup on first run, and start the initial sync automatically.

1.2.8.title: Requests Pipeline and Seerr Issues
1.2.8.body: Requests show a clearer requested → approved → grabbed → available timeline, with stage filters, richer cards, and an admin Issues inbox for Overseerr/Jellyseerr reports.

1.2.8.title: Per-User Request Folders
1.2.8.body: Set Films and TV root-folder overrides from the cog on user cards. Saving syncs open Seerr requests and moves linked Radarr/Sonarr titles onto those paths.

1.2.8.title: Multi-Campaign Newsletters
1.2.8.body: Create global, role-based, and personal newsletter campaigns with shared SMTP, section toggles, preview, and scheduled weekly or monthly sends.

1.2.8.title: Downloads and Sessions Polish
1.2.8.body: Remove items from the Downloads queue when supported, while Active Sessions cards truncate long titles and stream labels cleanly on desktop and mobile.

1.2.8.title: Snappier Loads and Steadier Integrations
1.2.8.body: Vendor chunks split further, common routes preload after login, Home/Requests responses cache briefly, and outbound HTTPS prefers IPv4 so Cloudflare-hosted Seerr/Arr hosts are more reliable on IPv6-less networks.

1.2.8.title: Release and CI Tooling
1.2.8.body: PR validation checks and dedicated GitHub Action bots are in place, and the release pipeline commits package version bumps so the app version matches the published GitHub tag.

1.2.7.title: Ten New Themes
1.2.7.body: Sakura, Volcanic, Deep Sea, Honey, Plasma, Moss, Paper, Electric Blue, Tangerine, and Violet Night are now available in Settings and the profile theme menu.

1.2.7.title: Richer Active Session Cards
1.2.7.body: Active session cards now show transcoded progress as a lighter progress-bar overlay, while expanded cards include the viewer profile picture and a client icon beside the client details.

1.2.7.title: A Note About Today's Updates
1.2.7.body: We are sorry for the three updates in one day. Route and proxy changes touched the frontend, API, authentication, artwork, activity, and third-party integrations together, so several quick releases were needed while those connected response paths were brought back into sync.

1.2.7.title: More Reliable Pages
1.2.7.body: Activity now avoids blank loading states and theme-related table crashes, while release notes continue to work when GitHub is rate-limited or older beta version names are present.

1.2.7.title: Mobile Navigation Polish
1.2.7.body: Mobile navigation and Settings tabs now stay within the viewport, scroll horizontally when needed, and no longer overlap the page content. Home cards and transcode cards are also more compact on smaller screens.

1.2.6.title: Ten New Themes
1.2.6.body: Sakura, Volcanic, Deep Sea, Honey, Plasma, Moss, Paper, Electric Blue, Tangerine, and Violet Night are now available in Settings and the profile theme menu.

1.2.6.title: Richer Active Session Cards
1.2.6.body: Active session cards now show transcoded progress as a lighter progress-bar overlay, while expanded cards include the viewer profile picture and a client icon beside the client details.

1.2.6.title: A Note About Today's Updates
1.2.6.body: We are sorry for the three updates in one day. Route and proxy changes touched the frontend, API, authentication, artwork, activity, and third-party integrations together, so several quick releases were needed while those connected response paths were brought back into sync.

1.2.6.title: More Reliable Pages
1.2.6.body: Activity now avoids blank loading states and theme-related table crashes, while release notes continue to work when GitHub is rate-limited or older beta version names are present.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Queue Rows
1.2.5.body: Queued Tdarr files now come from the same paged client data used by the Tdarr UI, so the Queue tab shows real media instead of only an aggregate count.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr History Rows
1.2.5.body: Finished and errored Tdarr jobs now display as history cards with the media name, posters, backdrops, finished format, source format, size changes, and saved space.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Refresh Reliability
1.2.5.body: Active, queued, and history response mapping now keeps worker progress, queue rows, history rows, and summary counts in the correct views.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Endpoint Handling
1.2.5.body: Tdarr refreshes no longer wait on the slow full database dump or blocking job-report lookups, keeping the dashboard responsive when optional endpoints are slow.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Active Artwork
1.2.5.body: Active transcode posters and backdrops now stay matched during live polling refreshes instead of disappearing between updates.

1.2.3.title: 3rd Party Apps
1.2.3.body: JellyGlance now pulls Wizarr invites, Tdarr transcodes, Maintainerr cleanup, and SickChill series automation into one clearer `3rd party apps` setup area.

1.2.3.title: Wizarr Invites
1.2.3.body: Create, copy, open, and manage Wizarr invites directly in JellyGlance without bouncing out to another app.

1.2.3.title: Tdarr And Maintainerr
1.2.3.body: Tdarr now has clearer active, queued, and history views, while Maintainerr adds cleanup monitoring, summary data, alerts, widgets, and its own dashboard page.

1.2.3.title: Settings And Kiosk
1.2.3.body: Settings now uses cleaner categories with a collapsible sidebar, and Kiosk has its own custom controls for title, density, theme, visible widgets, widget sizes, and widget order.

1.2.3.title: Home And Hall Of Fame
1.2.3.body: Hall of Fame has been polished up, and Home plus Kiosk now give you better widget ordering, layout control, and dashboard customisation.

1.2.3.title: Requests Upgraded
1.2.3.body: Requests now has a richer display, newer features, and more advanced management controls for handling request queues and approvals.

1.2.3.title: Activity And Statistics
1.2.3.body: The `/activity` view is cleaner to scan, and `/statistics` now presents summaries and watch trends with stronger visual structure.

1.2.3.title: Profiles And Privacy
1.2.3.body: The profile modal has been cleaned up, logout now lives there, font-weight options are available, and Active Sessions privacy controls let you choose where viewer IPs are hidden.

1.2.3.title: Libraries And Users
1.2.3.body: Libraries and Users both had a broader UI overhaul, including better list views and the option to hide selected users from stats and activity when needed.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Big UI Beta
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Home, Settings, Statistics, Requests, Activity, Users, Libraries, Hall of Fame, Wizarr, About, and integrations all had a broader redesign pass with cleaner spacing, cards, controls, and layout polish.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Tdarr Transcodes
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Tdarr now has an Active Transcodes page with active, queued, and history views, navigation counts, show artwork, conversion details, and live progress updates.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Smarter Settings
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Settings now uses grouped categories, a collapsible sidebar, cleaner routes, custom Kiosk controls, privacy options, sidebar ordering, hidden tabs, and a safer theme preview flow.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: 3rd Party Apps
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Integrations are grouped more clearly with Wizarr for invites, Tdarr for transcodes, Maintainerr for cleanup, and SickChill as an alternative to Sonarr for series automation.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Cleaner Requests
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Requests now has richer media cards, an optional list view, requester profile pictures, admin user filtering, tidier actions, newer request features, and more advanced management for admins.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Kiosk And Privacy
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Kiosk mode can stay static, refresh every 5 minutes, and use custom title, density, theme, visible widgets, widget sizes, and widget order. IP visibility can now be controlled for Home, Kiosk, both, or neither.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Hall Of Fame Glow-Up
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Hall of Fame now uses a podium-style layout with medal icons, and hidden users can be filtered out of Hall of Fame, Statistics, and Activity.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Statistics Rebuilt
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Statistics has clearer summary panels, redesigned watch stats, profile pictures, client icons, stronger visual hierarchy, and media links through to JellyGlance media pages where possible.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Sharper Polish
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Profile modal sizing, account labels, sidebar collapse, logout placement, profile hover pills, device icons, backup sizing, library and user list layouts, and several clipped or cramped screens have been cleaned up.

1.2.2.title: Invite People Faster
1.2.2.body: Create, copy, open, and remove Wizarr invite links without leaving JellyGlance. You can choose servers, libraries, access options, custom invite codes, and a wizard bundle ID when needed.

1.2.2.title: One Search for Requests
1.2.2.body: The Requests page now combines searching for new media and managing existing requests in one place, with faster filters, clearer cards, and request buttons that open the full setup flow.

1.2.2.title: Richer Media Details
1.2.2.body: Request details now show the information people actually check first: posters, summaries, cast, ratings, genres, requested seasons, requester avatars, and Jellyfin availability.

1.2.2.title: Better Activity Browsing
1.2.2.body: Activity history now includes media posters, cleaner title rows, and column controls so you can hide the fields you do not use.

1.2.2.title: Recently Added Filters
1.2.2.body: Recently Added now has search, media type and library filters, plus ordering controls for both items and shelves.

1.2.2.title: Profile Wrap-Up Improvements
1.2.2.body: User profiles now default to a clearer yearly activity heatmap, with a year selector, larger squares, and cleaner wrap-up cards.

1.2.2.title: Cleaner Settings
1.2.2.body: Settings tabs can be opened directly with links like /settings#plugins or /settings#apikeys, and the Plugins view now uses better Jellyfin artwork, spacing, and desktop card sizing.

1.2.2.title: Font Weight Preferences
1.2.2.body: The profile modal now lets you choose Default, Comfortable, or Light text weight, making JellyGlance easier to tune if the interface feels too bold.

1.2.2.title: Smarter Notifications
1.2.2.body: Invite events can now trigger webhooks, Invite Sync keeps links fresh in the background, Wizarr links copy with the correct public URL, and stable update checks ignore beta releases.

1.2.2.title: Email Wizarr Invites
1.2.2.body: Wizarr invites can now be emailed directly from JellyGlance using the built-in SMTP settings from Newsletter.

1.2.1.title: Jellyfin Jobs
1.2.1.body: Admins now get a dedicated Jellyfin Jobs page for viewing scheduled Jellyfin tasks, checking status, filtering by category, and starting jobs manually.

1.2.1.title: Cleaner Settings
1.2.1.body: Settings now has separate Authorised Devices and Plugins tabs, per-tab error boundaries, and a clearer embedded Repair section.

1.2.1.title: Smarter Navigation
1.2.1.body: Requests and Downloads now hide automatically when their services are not configured, while Jellyfin Jobs only appears for admins.

1.2.1.title: More Theme Choices
1.2.1.body: The profile theme picker includes more colour presets, with dark mode kept as the single supported appearance.

1.2.1.title: Activity and Logs Polish
1.2.1.body: Activity refreshes are calmer, table contrast is better, duplicate task toasts are reduced, and Logs is readable in the dark UI.

1.2.1.title: Release Notes on About
1.2.1.body: The About page now includes a release notes panel with a version dropdown and beta/stable release filtering.

1.2.1.title: No-Client Download Handling
1.2.1.body: Download queue sync now skips cleanly when no download clients are configured and avoids sending misleading completion notifications.

1.2.1.title: Security and Stability
1.2.1.body: The backend now has tighter CORS handling, security headers, body-size limits, rate limiting, skipped-task handling, and improved static asset lookup.

1.2.0.title: Quieter task notifications
1.2.0.body: Choose how much background task chatter you want to see, from every update to errors only, while manual actions still report back clearly.

1.2.0.title: Cleaner profile theming
1.2.0.body: The account modal now has a compact theme picker with colour previews, plus custom colour controls when you want a more personal dashboard.

1.2.0.title: Better newsletter previews
1.2.0.body: Newsletter setup now separates configuration from preview, renders the email in its own frame, and handles preview errors more gracefully.

1.2.0.title: Organized history imports
1.2.0.body: Jellystat and Tautulli import tools now live in clear Settings tabs, making legacy watch-history imports easier to find and manage.

1.2.0.title: Smoother mobile layouts
1.2.0.body: Headers, account controls, active session cards, import screens, and Settings navigation have all been tightened up for smaller screens.

1.2.0.title: Home starts with activity
1.2.0.body: New default home layouts now lead with Active Sessions, putting the live state of your Jellyfin server front and center.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Notification controls
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Settings now includes in-app notification controls so automatic task noise can be reduced while manual task feedback stays visible.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Profile theme picker
1.1.7-beta.3.body: The account modal now uses a compact theme dropdown with colour previews, with custom colours still available underneath.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Newsletter preview tabs
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Newsletter settings now separates configuration from preview, with the email preview rendered in its own document frame.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Import tabs
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Jellystat and Tautulli import tools now sit behind clear tabs inside Settings for easier testing.

1.1.7-beta.2.title: Mobile app navigation
1.1.7-beta.2.body: The mobile bottom dock has been replaced with a full-screen app launcher opened from the JellyGlance header.

1.1.7-beta.2.title: Jellystat history imports
1.1.7-beta.2.body: The beta build keeps Jellystat and Tautulli history import work available for testing before the next stable release.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Beta channel
1.1.7-beta.1.body: This build is published from the BETA branch with its own prerelease versioning and Docker beta tags.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Jellystat history imports
1.1.7-beta.1.body: First-run setup can import Jellystat history alongside Tautulli so legacy watch data can come across before the first sync.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Smoother first-run setup
1.1.7-beta.1.body: After Jellyfin is connected, setup now moves into integrations, optional history import, and first sync without asking for the server again.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Active session readability
1.1.7-beta.1.body: Long stream, subtitle, title, and user values now truncate more cleanly, especially on mobile session cards.

1.1.6.title: Tautulli history imports
1.1.6.body: Upload old Tautulli backups, preview them, append watch history safely, and repair unmatched media links.

1.1.6.title: Active session popouts
1.1.6.body: Click a live session card for a richer playback inspector with stream, device, user, progress, and transcode details.

1.1.6.title: Custom profile theming
1.1.6.body: New theme controls and presets let JellyGlance feel more personal across the dashboard.

1.1.6.title: Faster profile pages
1.1.6.body: Profile stats and media sections now load with targeted requests, cache reuse, and clearer loading counts.

1.1.6.title: What's new popup
1.1.6.body: JellyGlance now shows update notes once per version, with a manual button in the profile menu whenever you want to revisit them.

1.1.6.title: Activity refresh fixes
1.1.6.body: Activity pages now refresh after imports and handle imported history more reliably.

1.1.6.title: Better session readability
1.1.6.body: Active session timing and playback text have been tightened up so live cards are easier to scan.

1.1.6.title: Repair Hub
1.1.6.body: A new navbar page pulls media repair work into one place, including missing artwork, runtime gaps, empty series, orphaned activity, and unmatched imported history.

1.1.6.title: Newsletter generator
1.1.6.body: Configure SMTP, preview a JellyGlance digest, send test emails, and manually email recently added media, top watched items, active viewers, and repair status.
